title: PunchBench: Benchmarking MLLMs in Multimodal Punchline Comprehension

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance drops when original captions are replaced with synonymous or antonymous captions to detect if models rely on linguistic shortcuts (specific biased words) rather than true multimodal comprehension.
Randomizing the order in which candidate captions or multiple-choice options are displayed within instruction templates to prevent models from exploiting positional artifacts.
